sota_sources.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
sota_sources.key_finding: Uncertainty quantification (MC dropout + bootstrap CI) improves calibration and betting decision quality for NBA market predictions

sota_sources.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
sota_sources.key_finding: Stacked ensemble: SVM 77.49% accuracy, AutoGluon 77.38%, DNN 77.26%. Ensemble methods consistently outperform single-model approaches.

sota_sources.title: Comparing Machine Learning Methods for NBA Game Outcome Prediction
sota_sources.key_finding: CNN achieves Brier 0.221; Logistic Regression achieves 0.199; XGBoost 0.202 on NBA game prediction

sota_sources.title: Key Factors Influencing NBA Game Outcomes: A Machine Learning Study
sota_sources.key_finding: SHAP analysis identifies top predictive factors; feature importance aligns with our GA selection patterns

sota_sources.title: Machine Learning for Basketball Game Outcomes: NBA and WNBA Leagues
sota_sources.key_finding: LightGBM competitive with XGBoost; ensemble superiority confirmed across NBA/WNBA domains

brier_benchmarks.note: Our fleet is competitive with CNN SOTA (0.221). LR 0.199 likely on different dataset/split. S15 gen-2471 obs 0.21954 approaches CNN performance territory.

fleet_observation.s15_breakthrough: S15 extra_trees 38-feature model observed at Brier=0.21954 (gen 2471) — approaching CNN SOTA from tree-model side. API best_brier=0.22028 confirmed below 0.22085 checkpoint threshold.
fleet_observation.compact_feature_signal: S15 at 38 features vs 200f cap shows over-parameterization reduction helps. GA is learning to prune. S14 also at only 26 features post-reset.
fleet_observation.implication: Consider reducing MAX_FEATURES target to 50 from 200 for newly seeded islands. The GA converges to compact sets anyway — tighter cap would accelerate convergence.

proposals.title: Cross-island elite injection of S15's 38-feature extra_trees configuration
proposals.rationale: S15 gen-2471 obs Brier=0.21954 with 38 features is the fleet's best observed result. Injecting this feature mask as an elite individual into S13/S18/S22 seeds the search from a strong compact configuration.
proposals.implementation: POST /api/command {"action": "inject_elite", "feature_mask": "s15_gen2471_top38"} to Nomos42/nba-evo-4 (S13) and TESTforge42/nba-evo-s18 (S18). Let each island's GA adapt from this compact seed.
proposals.expected_impact: 0.001-0.003 Brier improvement if 38f pattern generalizes across models
proposals.blocker: Need S15's exact feature indices — available from /api/status top_performer field

proposals.title: Add isotonic recalibration post-step to tree island predictions
proposals.rationale: MDPI 2026 uncertainty-aware paper + our TabICL result (calibrated 0.22054 vs raw 0.22169 — delta 0.001) confirm isotonic recalibration improves Brier. Tree fleet does not currently apply isotonic calibration.
proposals.implementation: In each island's evaluate_individual(): wrap tree.predict_proba()[:,1] with sklearn.isotonic.IsotonicRegression().fit(val_proba, val_y) on held-out 20% temporal split. Replace raw proba with calibrated proba for Brier scoring.
proposals.risk: Must use temporal split for calibration (no leakage). Adds ~50ms per individual evaluation on CPU.

proposals.title: S17 restart and re-seeding from S15 elite
proposals.rationale: S17 LBJLincoln26/nba-evo-s17 has been DOWN 503 for 8+ cycles (>32h). Once restarted, seed population with S15's compact 38f configuration to accelerate convergence.
proposals.implementation: VM: curl -X POST https://huggingface.co/api/spaces/LBJLincoln26/nba-evo-s17/restart. After restart, POST /api/command inject_elite from S15.
proposals.expected_impact: Restores fleet slot. XGBoost specialist with S15 seed may achieve 0.220-0.221 range.

proposals.title: Diversify P7 toward compact feature counts (NBA rotation C)
proposals.rationale: Political rotation C: port NBA techniques. S15's 38f success pattern applicable to political. P7 at brier=0.25412 (highest in fleet, worst performer) with 45 features and 60 individuals. Diversify with compact-feature pressure may break plateau.
proposals.expected_impact: 0.002-0.005 improvement in P7 brier if compact-feature pattern generalizes to political domain
